summary: A host that confirms a batch -- deleting the checked records -- first refuses it with confirm_required and a digest, and applies it when raised again with that digest. Nothing is written before.

then.note: reason is confirm_required; the summary in data.confirm says what happens to the records. Both records are still in the store. The same payload with confirm set to data.confirm.digest is answered applied; with another digest, refused. A stale revision is still answered with a conflict, confirmed or not.
